correctness.rationale: Exact equivalence of component size and induced degree at most one is established; the two graph realizations and all 2^20 face tests agree. A complete pair-uniqueness check gives 31,003 pairs; in each of two independently chosen matchings one vertex and 41 seven-cells remain. Directed Hasse acyclicity is checked exhaustively over 400,760 edges, with all 62,048 faces topologically sorted. Forman’s theorem gives a CW complex with a point and 41 seven-cells, so the integral wedge follows with constant attaching maps. Source and recorded output are embedded and executable.

value.rationale: This is a natural first higher-independence/devoid complex on the canonical Desargues incidence graph, extending the studied P3-devoid topology from forests and cycles to a nonchordal symmetric cubic graph. Its nonpure facets occur in sizes 8, 9, 10 and 12, while the exact homotopy type has 41 seven-sphere summands. This is not recoverable from earlier Desargues ordinary-independence or matching results and offers a substantive exact topology benchmark; no broader result is claimed.
